## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the boolean operator that combines a logical constraint's members — AND, OR, XONE, or AND-sequence — by referencing a [`gmeow:ConstraintLogic`](../classes/gmeow-ConstraintLogic.md) value.

### Avoid when

- Avoid giving one logical constraint several logics (it is functional) and avoid putting it on an atomic constraint; the operator combines members, it does not compare a value.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:constraintLogic`](gmeow-constraintLogic.md) once per [`LogicalConstraint`](../classes/gmeow-LogicalConstraint.md) (functional) to a [`gmeow:ConstraintLogic`](../classes/gmeow-ConstraintLogic.md) value over its [`gmeow:logicConstraintMember`](gmeow-logicConstraintMember.md) parts.

### Examples

- ex:euAndUntil2030 [`gmeow:constraintLogic`](gmeow-constraintLogic.md) [`gmeow:logicAnd`](../individuals/gmeow-logicAnd.md).
